headline: Train drivers have had enough and announce a nationwide strike. Railway delays expected
summary: Train drivers in Poland announced a nationwide strike following a fatal accident at a railway crossing near Przysucha. Prime Minister Donald Tusk has called for radical changes to regulations.
why: Polish rail operators such as PKP move freight and passengers across Poland, so industrial action affects logistics and supply chains.
